reviewMethod: Local image inspection after Playwright Chromium capture

screenshots.finding: The comparison stem is answerable and choices are readable, but the card reserves a large unused vertical region.
The mobile choices are readable and do not overflow; this is still one repeated text-only template.
Numeric input renders correctly, but this is explicitly a static-bank renderer control; the semantic generator produced zero numeric-input samples.
CRITICAL: 'nhận biết phân số' does not specify an operation, yet the answer is the decimal sum of 7/3 and 5/7; no fraction visual is shown.
The equation is mathematically answerable, but distractors are adjacent values and the same template is reused across seeds and difficulties.
HIGH: the rectangle visual uses 38 cm and 12 cm while the prompt includes an unexplained third value 2 cm; answer choices omit cm².
HIGH: the chart is legible but labels are generic and the prompt never asks which quantity/statistic to identify; the solver silently chooses the maximum.

HIGH: correct-state structure is accessible, but the explanation only says to read data and perform the required reasoning; it never explains why 16 is greatest. The skip link is also visibly exposed while feedback has focus.
HIGH: incorrect feedback repeats the same generic steps as correct feedback and gives no misconception-specific help. The skip link is also visibly exposed while feedback has focus.
Completion routing controls render, but the summary reports only score and does not identify the skill improved or next semantic recommendation.
The empty state explains that progress is saved, but provides no explicit reload/retry control.
The error remains readable and the same selected answer can be retried; the large desktop card still leaves unused space.

criticalHighIssues: Invalid/ambiguous fraction task and unrelated scoring operation
Area visual/prompt data mismatch and missing squared unit
Chart prompt lacks a concrete query
Correct and incorrect feedback are generic and identical in substance
mediumIssues: Desktop simple-question cards have excessive empty space
Completion and empty states are not generator-aware enough
The skip link remains visible during focused correct/incorrect feedback
diagnosticCorrections: The first touch-target result counted a hidden 0×0 mobile-menu button; the final visible-only check passes.
reasonNotFixed: Sprint 8A is an audit baseline. Only diagnostic and artifact-generation code was changed.
